design_tradeoff.chosen: Minimal private Bitbucket preservation projection plus existing CoreGit/CoreTasks owners. Validated exact candidate push receipt is a completed fact; synchronous next-effect admission stays separate. Both prNow saves read current matching ownership and preserve its metadata.
design_tradeoff.flexible_alternative: Generic raw PR replay or negotiated credential modes would enlarge unsupported surface and leak provider details. Not needed for these confirmed contracts.
design_tradeoff.common_caller_alternative: Adding title/reviewers/retention/raw metadata to the shared Forge interface would make CoreTasks learn Bitbucket PUT rules. Projection remains private to the deep Bitbucket helper.
design_tradeoff.concurrency_limit: Immediately preceding validated GET plus unconditional PUT cannot prevent a concurrent maintainer/provider update between read and write. No CAS/conditional/native atomic guarantee is claimed.
